brief:
All four supporting acts have withdrawn from Ed Sheeran's Loop tour in solidarity with Macklemore, The Guardian reported. Macklemore was removed from the tour following comments he made in support of Palestine, prompting the three other opening acts and Sheeran's live band to depart.

The withdrawals leave the upcoming dates without their planned roster of performers ahead of scheduled shows.

title: Four opening acts quit Sheeran tour over Macklemore's removal
